name: Manaltheeram Ayurveda Beach Village
summary: Manaltheeram is an Ayurveda beach village in Chowara, a fishing village south of Kovalam, and a sister resort of Somatheeram. Guests stay in cottages and Kerala-style houses and follow Ayurveda programmes with yoga and meditation; Kerala Tourism lists it under the Green Leaf classification.
